audioNote.markdown: Welcome to Sessionboard! In this video, we’ll walk through how to enable file collection through sessions, making it easy for your team to review and share files with external teams—like A.V.—on event day.

steps.title: Session Files

audioNote.markdown: Before collecting files from your speakers, you’ll need to enable file collection. To do this, go to the Sessions module, open the Settings page, and select the Files sub-tab.

steps.description: Before collecting files from your speakers, you’ll need to enable file collection. To do this, go to the Sessions module, open the Settings page, and select the Files sub-tab.

select the file subtab.

steps.title: Enable File Upload

audioNote.markdown: Toggle the icon under ‘Enable File Upload’ to allow session files to be submitted through the portal. This will reveal additional settings where you can set a due date, specify accepted file types, and limit the number of files speakers can upload per session.

audioNote.markdown: Speakers can leave comments on each file they submit. To view them, click Comments beneath the file to expand the section. Please note that email notifications are not sent when comments are added by either the event organizer or the speakers. To communicate to speakers that they have a new comment, we recommend sending them an email.
